method: Inspect historical metadata, marker contexts and commit/landing excerpts in the predeclared stratified sample. This is an AI-assisted evidence review, not human ground truth.
limitations: Equal-per-repo stratification is not self-weighting; raw sample percentages must not be reported as population precision.
No-evidence findings do not certify human authorship or establish recall.
Four baseline positives have unclear direct merged-change authorship: one non-committed reproduction example and three subtree imports.
Five previously unmarked/automation PRs have affirmative disclosures missed by named-tool rules; they motivated a separately disclosed exploratory extension.
Independent human labels remain blank and are not overwritten by this AI review.
